questions.question: During an authorized security review, an assessor observes: a seemingly helpful program executes malicious functionality without self-replicating. Which concept BEST describes this finding?

options.A: Trojan horse
options.B: Backdoor
options.C: Remote-access Trojan
options.D: Computer worm

questions.explanation: This is an example of trojan horse: a seemingly helpful program executes malicious functionality without self-replicating. A relevant security consideration is to allow software only from trusted and verified sources.

questions.question: An exam asks about the appropriate handling of Trojan horse. Which statement is BEST?

options.A: Patch reachable systems and segment networks
options.B: Allow software only from trusted and verified sources
options.C: Monitor unexpected remote control and limit endpoint privileges
options.D: Scan untrusted files and reduce uncontrolled execution

questions.explanation: The best recommendation for trojan horse is to allow software only from trusted and verified sources; this directly addresses the issue described by the concept.
